qasam hai unn ghorron ki jo haanp haanp ker dorrtay hain ,
phir jo ( apni taapon say ) chingariyan uratay hain ,
phir subha kay waqt yalghaar kertay hain ,
phir uss moaqa per ghubar uratay hain ,
phir ussi waqt kissi jhamgathay kay beechon beech ja-ghustay hain ,
kay insan apney perwerdigar ka bara nashukra hai ,
aur woh khud iss baat ka gawah hai .
aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh maal ki mohabbat mein boht paka hai .
bhala kiya woh waqt ussay maloom nahi hai jab qabron mein jo kuch hai , ussay bahir bikhair diya jaye ga ,
aur seenon mein jo kuch hai , ussay zahir kerdiya jaye ga .
yaqeenan unn ka perwerdigar uss din unn ( ki jo halat hogi uss ) say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .
